create_iterable_dataset_from_generator: create an IterableDataset from a generator function with optional features and shard configuration
test_iterable_dataset_map: test the IterableDataset.map method to apply a transformation function to each example
test_iterable_dataset_filter: test the IterableDataset.filter method to remove examples not matching a predicate
test_iterable_dataset_shuffle: test the IterableDataset.shuffle method with a buffer and seed for reproducible randomization
test_interleave_datasets: test interleave_datasets to merge multiple IterableDatasets with optional probabilities and stopping strategy
